notes.title: Even more achievements!
notes.content:
Hello!

We have put in another 9 achievements! Almost all of them use existing stats so if you have played the game previously everything will transfer over!

Other than that, there are a few updates:
[list]
[*] When you get Protection it now shows on your health bar
[*] Audio has been modified and hopefully aren't as loud and are now stereo
[*] The same Powerups now stack, sorry about that!
[/list]

Other than that, have a great one, hide your wallet out there... its a dangerous two weeks!

-
Karl

notes.title: More Achievements a bit early!
notes.content:
9 new achievements went up today!

I also had the pleasure of watching a [url=https://www.twitch.tv/saintlyoni/]streamer [/url]get the high score. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33936777/02da5d39bb109fa1a5050f86828b1c82543d3535.png[/img]

Its a crazy ride and you can watch the video [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/435383780?t=03h6m05s]here![/url]

There was also a few more things in the patch there will be a more detailed update in the update thread. 

This patch went out a little earlier than planned!  So hopefully everything is good for you all!

-
Karl.

notes.title: Updates from the few days
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33936777/013d471c8f0f603e8919e10a34a642d5b32c38c2.gif[/img]

Hi everyone,

To stop people camping on the ground for extended periods of time, we thought about it long and hard and decided to make the difficult decision to make you lose damage, this does take some time to kick in and doesn't kick in strait away - as you can see above. 

But in other notes, we have some updates and hot fixes that have taken place over the last few days: 

[b]1.05.002[/b]
Fix for the menu's with controllers. 
Made the mouse visible in the menu when exiting the game
Lowered Pew Pew Pew Pew! achievement by 5000 kills. 
Increasing a few power up timers. 

[b]1.05.001[/b]
New Achievements!
Enemy kills achievements are now tracked through steam stats for better tracking.
The floor now causes damage if you sit there for too long (this is stop a potential exploit).

[b]1.04[/b]
Bringing the bounding walls in a tiny bit so the enemies don't get stuck on the edge
Leaderboard should show your new score correctly at the end of the level.
[b]
1.03[/b]
Mac version works correctly with steam integration 
Fixed Spiral Shot not lasting as long as it should
Fixed Achievement Pew Pew Pew! and Pew Pew Pew Pew!! not unlocking.
Stat orbs can now be picked up from above
New Stat for the Star Cannon enemy

[b]1.02[/b]
Control rebinding should now work when you exit and restart the game.
Meteor sounds are a little lower than before.
Friends button on leaderboard should function correctly.

notes.title: Finishing Touches left to do!
notes.content:
[h1]Wooo![/h1]

Power Gunner is almost done! Just a few tiny bits and pieces to put together and things should be there!  

It's really just controller support that needs to be ticked off!  There is even a chance we will push the release date forward!

However there are [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751230/Hyper_Slasher/]other[/url] titles we are working on as well!

If you have any questions or want to know anything, please let us know!  Currently the game is set to launch at the price of $1USD (local currency may vary)
